I'm Bowie, and I'm here about the job.
Nice office. Is this chair supposed to spin? It's very spinny.
Yes, that's my résumé. It's short. It only says one thing.
I do the work.
Most AI will tell you how to build a website, in a long list of steps, and then wish you luck.
I build it. I test it. And I put it online.

beats.msg: My launch is tomorrow and I have no website. Prove it.

beats.say: Deal. Hand me your laptop.
This is Bowers. You tell me what you want in plain words, and I get to work. No setup screens, no settings maze.
I read your project first, so I build on what's already there.
Then I write the files, start a little server, and open the page in a real browser to check it actually works.
You can see every step I take, and open any of them for the details.
Hmm. No. Even I can't ship that.
Good news: every change I make has an undo. One click, and your files are back exactly how they were. So, take two.
Lemon Lane. Your order form, delivery times, and zero errors in the browser console.
The live preview sits right next to our chat, with the code, GitHub, and a terminal one tab away.
One click on Deploy, and it's live.

beats.msg: Cute. Now I need a video for socials.

beats.say: Videos are my favourite.
Bowers Motion turns an idea into a video with sound, powered by LTX, once you add your key. Pick the shape, the length and the resolution, up to 4K.
Or I write the video in code, frame by frame, with HyperFrames, so every render comes out exactly the same.
Vertical, ready for Reels and TikTok.
And for pictures, switch Motion to photo. Logos, posters, thumbnails, or edits to your own photos, all saved to your library.
Uh oh. Your laptop is struggling.
Good thing fixing computers is on my résumé too. In very small letters.
Bowers Care checks your memory, your disk, and how long you've been running, and tells you what's wrong in plain English.
Your disk is almost full. The fix is right there.
Slow computer, no internet, an app that keeps crashing, a scary error message. Pick the problem, or paste the error, and I'll walk you through it, on Windows, Mac or Linux.

beats.msg: Should I buy shares in a lemon company? 🍋

beats.say: Ooh, a money question.
The Trading Desk sends a team of analysts. One reads the fundamentals, one reads the news, one reads the charts.
Then a bull and a bear argue it out, so you see both sides before you decide.
It's research only. I never place trades. That part is always your call.

beats.say: Math Lab. Not just the answer. The steps, so it makes sense.
It factors into x minus two, times x minus three.
So x is two, or three. And here's the graph, crossing the line right at two and three.
Labs is full of extras like that. A model arena where two AIs answer the same question and you pick the winner. A 3D studio. An emote maker for Twitch and Discord. Website audits.
This is Aether, my voice mode. Like a real assistant. You talk, I answer out loud.
Just the launch post. Everything else is done.
My voice runs right on your computer, with the open Kokoro model. Free, offline, and private. Or pick another voice in the voice studio.
Aether also learns. Tell me once that you like short answers, and I remember it from then on.
And here's your whole day in the Knowledge Graph. Projects, files, memories and goals, all connected, with me in the middle.

chapters.q: Do you work well with others?

beats.say: Very well. I brought a team.
Twenty eight specialist helpers I can hand work to. A codebase cartographer, a film director, a growth marketer, a math tutor.
And a reality checker, who keeps the rest of us honest.
Plus seventy eight open-source projects, one click away. HyperFrames and Remotion for video, Sandcastle for running coding agents in sandboxes, and plenty more.
Developers feel right at home.
I connect to GitHub, make branches, open pull requests, and keep an eye on their checks.
I understand code with language servers, so I can jump to any definition and find every place it's used.
And Bowers Forge is your coding workspace. Your files, a full terminal, and deploy, side by side.
Every project we touch is saved, with a preview, so you can jump back in.
Need a head start? Begin from a template. A landing page, a dashboard, a browser game, a mobile app.
Every image, video and document lands in your library.
Press Control K anywhere, and I'll take you to any page in a second. Dark mode or light, it's your space.
Honestly? I ask a lot of questions.
I ask before anything risky. Every time. You choose how much freedom I get.
Plugins from the internet stay switched off until you say yes. And your keys stay on your computer, never in a chat.
Right. The last thing on the list.
Short, friendly, with the link and the delivery times. Written in your voice, because I've read everything you've written today.
Post it in the morning. I'll remind you.
I'm hired? I'm hired!
